inputs.format: strict three-line records: header, codon line, count line
inputs.identity_conflicts: duplicate transcript ID or duplicate exact normalized CDS is a fatal input conflict

expected_label_free_qc.scope: development input sequence/count QC only; no scientific split or hyperparameter grid changes

rejection_reasons.rejected_missing_terminal_stop: last codon is not TAA, TAG or TGA
rejection_reasons.rejected_internal_stop: TAA, TAG or TGA occurs before the terminal codon
rejection_reasons.rejected_no_unmasked_positive_position: no count > 0.5 remains at zero-based positions 5 through L - 5

expected_label_free_qc.accounting: 1761 input - 171 missing ATG - 517 coverage = 1073 eligible; all other rejection categories and ID/exact CDS conflicts are zero

preprocessing.density_rule: count / mean(count[count > 0.5]) using all positions in that transcript
preprocessing.loss_evaluation_mask: (count > 0.5) and zero-based position >= 5 and position < L - 4
preprocessing.identity_rule: transcript ID and exact normalized CDS must each be unique
preprocessing.terminal_stop_rule: last codon must be TAA, TAG or TGA
preprocessing.internal_stop_rule: no TAA, TAG or TGA before the terminal codon
preprocessing.qc_rejection_precedence: length, ATG, terminal stop, internal stop, coverage, unmasked positive position
preprocessing.normalization_scope: within each transcript only; no cross-transcript fitted statistic

split.outer_test_use: final prediction and metrics only after inner hyperparameter selection and early stopping are complete
split.inner_validation_use: plateau early stopping and out-of-fold hyperparameter selection
split.final_predictor: equal-weight density ensemble of the three selected inner-fold models

model.position_score_field: relative_position_weight * i / (L - 1), without codon parameters or bias
model.objective: mean over transcripts of masked-position MSE

hyperparameters.selection_metric: inner out-of-fold transcript-balanced MSE at each fold's restored best-validation state

evaluation.undefined_constant_correlations: null with defined counts; never zero
evaluation.kinetic_effect: primary: independent TB-MSE minus kinetic TB-MSE; positive favors kinetic
evaluation.position_control_effect: position TB-MSE minus kinetic TB-MSE; positive favors kinetic over the simple position control
evaluation.steady_state_diagnostic: maximum absolute residual/J computed separately for every selected inner kinetic member

outputs.startup_provenance: protocol, implementation and mean-field operator SHA256 recorded before device probe, raw parsing or training
outputs.selected_inner_states: every outer/arm/seed selected inner best state, model configuration and selection hyperparameters; predictions rebuildable without refitting
outputs.prediction_arrays: target, mask, codons, outer fold, all three arms' density, ensemble-mean flux diagnostic and member-level solver residual diagnostics
outputs.ensemble_mean_residual_diagnostic: arithmetic diagnostic only; not a common steady-state residual
outputs.sha256: startup protocol, implementation and mean-field operator hashes plus raw input and every non-summary artifact

limitations: Mohammad16 is an observed development study, not final research OOD or untouched evaluation.
The comparison tests a minimal flux-conservation inductive bias; it does not establish a positive kinetic effect, SOTA, or absolute physical rates.
The algebraic mean field is not an exact stochastic ribosome simulation.
Reaching the epoch ceiling is recorded as not converged and is never relabeled as plateau convergence.
Independent and kinetic have matched 65-parameter score fields; position is deliberately a one-parameter simple control.
Each kinetic ensemble member is separately solver-conserved; the density/flux/residual means are not a common steady state.
The three-member count is matched across arms and is not an extra ensemble-size advantage for kinetic.
